## Featured project

### [SpeakBetter AI](https://github.com/Kesavamoorthig06/speak-better-ai)

A modern AI-powered public speaking coach designed to analyze delivery quality through voice, video, and speech insights.

- Eye contact analysis
- Filler word detection
- Speech pace and clarity tracking
- Presentation feedback and reporting
